(c) Since you’ve got a family history of Type 2 diabetes on your mom’s side, you might want to go for breakfasts with steady energy and lower added sugars — think oatmeal topped with berries and a sprinkle of nuts, or scrambled eggs with avocado on whole grain toast. These options can help keep your energy up and blood sugar levels more stable until lunch. You could even add a side of Greek yogurt for extra protein and creaminess!
(d) Since you’re training for your school’s 5K run, you might want to go for breakfasts that give you sustained energy — think oatmeal topped with berries and a sprinkle of nuts, or scrambled eggs with avocado on whole grain toast. These options can help fuel your run and keep you energized until lunch. You could even add a side of Greek yogurt for extra protein and creaminess!
